rows.pair: Net point differential vs Displayed win percentage
rows.reason: Mechanical: wins and net points move together by construction in a small sample.

rows.pair: Net point differential vs Actual minus expected wins
rows.reason: Structurally induced: the expectation is computed from PF and PA, which also define net points, so the two sides are not independent measurements.

rows.pair: Displayed win percentage vs Actual minus expected wins
rows.reason: Tautological: the residual subtracts a function of PF/PA from wins while PCT is wins divided by games, so both series contain the same win count.
